feats.title: Avandra's Gift
feats.description: When you use your second chance racial power and the enemy's attack misses, you gain combat advantage for the next attack roll you make against that enemy before the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Bleeding Backstab
feats.description: Whenever you deal Sneak Attack damage to a target with a rogue daily attack power, the target takes ongoing 5 damage (save ends). If the power already deals ongoing damage that has no damage type, instead increase that ongoing damage by 5.

feats.title: Brutal Bludgeon
feats.description: When you hit with a club or a mace, you treat the weapon as though it had the brutal 1 property: Reroll any damage die result of 1 until the die shows 2 or higher.

feats.title: Combat Opportunist
feats.description: Whenever one of your allies hits an enemy with an opportunity attack, that enemy grants combat advantage to you until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Cull the Weak
feats.description: When you have combat advantage against a bloodied or a weakened target, you gain a +2 bonus to melee weapon damage rolls against the target.

feats.title: Disheartening Ambush
feats.description: Whenever you would deal Sneak Attack damage, you can forgo one die of that damage to give your attack the rattling keyword.

feats.title: Dragon Breath Scoundrel
feats.description: When you use your Dragon Breath racial power, you can expend your Sneak Attack for this turn to deal your Sneak Attack damage to each enemy you hit that is granting combat advantage to you.

feats.title: Elusive Movement
feats.description: Whenever you end your turn at least 3 squares away from where you began your turn, you gain a +1 feat bonus to AC and Reflex until the start of your next turn.

feats.title: Evasive Footwork
feats.description: When you shift 2 or more squares on your turn, you gain a +1 bonus to AC and Reflex until the start of your next turn.

feats.title: Expert Sneak
feats.description: You have combat advantage against enemies that are deafened, immobilized, slowed, or weakened.

feats.title: Infernal Sneak Attack
feats.description: When you deal your Sneak Attack damage, you can expend your infernal wrath to deal 1d6 extra fire damage for each die of Sneak Attack damage you deal.

feats.title: Opportunistic Sneak Attack
feats.description: When you hit with an opportunity attack and deal Sneak Attack damage, the target is slowed until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Prime Slayer
feats.description: While none of your allies are closer to your target than you are, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls for ranged attacks against that target.

feats.title: Rogue Weapon Mastery
feats.description: When you wield a dagger or a shuriken, the weapon gains the high crit property.

feats.title: Roundabout Charge
feats.description: When you charge, each square of your movement need not bring you closer to the target of your charge, but you must start the charge at least 3 squares away from the target.

feats.title: Sneaky Opportunity
feats.description: Your opportunity attacks with light blades deal 1d6 extra damage. This extra damage increases to 2d6 at 21st level.

feats.title: Unerring Ambush
feats.description: During the first round of combat, when you attack a creature that has not yet acted, you can make two attack rolls and use either result.
